metadata.title: A Differential Equation for Modeling Nesterov's Accelerated Gradient Method: Theory and Insights
metadata.authors: Weijie Su, Stephen Boyd, Emmanuel J. Candès

nodes.name: Convex minimization problem
nodes.statement: Minimize $f(x)$ where $f$ is a convex function (smooth or non-smooth) and $x \in \mathbb{R}^n$.
nodes.statement_clean: Find a minimizer of a convex function over $\mathbb{R}^n$.

nodes.name: Composite convex minimization
nodes.statement: Minimize $f(x) = g(x) + h(x)$ with $g \in \mathcal{F}_L$ smooth and $h$ a structured general convex function possibly assuming $+\infty$.
nodes.statement_clean: Minimize a sum of a smooth convex function and a structured (possibly nonsmooth) convex function.

nodes.name: Class $\mathcal{F}_L$ of $L$-smooth convex functions
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}_L$ is the class of convex functions $f$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$ that are continuously differentiable with $L$-Lipschitz gradient: $\|\nabla f(x)-\nabla f(y)\| \le L\|x-y\|$.

nodes.name: Class $\mathcal{S}_\mu$ of $\mu$-strongly convex functions
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{S}_\mu$ is the class of $\mu$-strongly convex $C^1$ functions $f$ on $\mathbb{R}^n$, meaning $f(x)-\mu\|x\|^2/2$ is convex; set $\mathcal{S}_{\mu,L} = \mathcal{F}_L \cap \mathcal{S}_\mu$.

nodes.name: $\mathcal{F}_\infty$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F}_\infty := \bigcup_{L>0}\mathcal{F}_L$, the union of all $L$-smooth convex classes.

nodes.name: Proximal subgradient $G_s$
nodes.statement: $G_s(x) := (x - \arg\min_z(\|z-(x-s\nabla g(x))\|^2/(2s)+h(z)))/s$.
nodes.statement_clean: Generalized gradient mapping that combines a forward gradient step on the smooth part with the proximal operator of the nonsmooth part.

nodes.name: Directional subgradient $G(x,p;f)$
nodes.statement: A Borel measurable $G(x,p)$ such that $G(x,p)\in\partial f(x)$ and $\langle G(x,p),p\rangle = \sup_{\xi\in\partial f(x)}\langle\xi,p\rangle$ for all $x,p$.
nodes.statement_clean: Subgradient choice that captures the directional derivative of $f$ at $x$ along $p$.

nodes.name: Speed restarting time $T(x_0;f)$
nodes.statement: $T(x_0;f) := \sup\{t>0 : \forall u\in(0,t),~ \d\|\dot X(u)\|^2/\d u > 0\}$, the first time the velocity $\|\dot X\|$ stops increasing.

nodes.name: Nesterov's accelerated gradient scheme
nodes.statement: Iterative first-order scheme with momentum: $x_k = y_{k-1} - s\nabla f(y_{k-1})$ and $y_k = x_k + \frac{k-1}{k+2}(x_k - x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Generalized Nesterov's scheme (parameter $r$)
nodes.statement: Composite-form generalization with momentum coefficient $(k-1)/(k+r-1)$: $x_k = y_{k-1} - sG_s(y_{k-1})$ and $y_k = x_k + \frac{k-1}{k+r-1}(x_k-x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Speed Restarting Nesterov's Scheme
nodes.statement: Discrete proximal Nesterov scheme that restarts the momentum index $j$ to 1 whenever $\|x_k-x_{k-1}\| < \|x_{k-1}-x_{k-2}\|$ and $j \ge k_{\min}$.

nodes.name: Forward Euler discretization of the smoothed ODE
nodes.statement: Two-step forward Euler scheme for the smoothed ODE: $X^\delta_{k+1} = X^\delta_k + \Delta t Z^\delta_k$ and $Z^\delta_{k+1} = (1 - 3\Delta t/\max\{\delta,k\Delta t\}) Z^\delta_k - \Delta t \nabla f(X^\delta_k)$.
output: Discrete trajectory $\{X^\delta_k\}$ approximating the smoothed ODE solution

nodes.name: Nesterov's ODE (key)
nodes.statement: $\ddot{X} + \frac{3}{t}\dot{X} + \nabla f(X) = 0$, $t>0$, with $X(0)=x_0$, $\dot X(0)=0$.

nodes.name: Generalized ODE with damping $r/t$
nodes.statement: $\ddot X + \frac{r}{t}\dot X + \nabla f(X) = 0$ with $X(0)=x_0$, $\dot X(0)=0$, parameterized by $r$.

nodes.name: Smoothed ODE
nodes.statement: $\ddot X + \frac{3}{\max(\delta,t)}\dot X + \nabla f(X) = 0$ with $X(0)=x_0,\dot X(0)=0$.

nodes.name: Speed-restarted ODE
nodes.statement: $\ddot X(t) + \frac{3}{t_{\mathrm{sr}}}\dot X(t) + \nabla f(X(t)) = 0$ where $t_{\mathrm{sr}}$ is reset to 0 at each restart and grows like $t$ between restarts.

nodes.name: Composite-optimization ODE
nodes.statement: $\ddot X + \frac{3}{t}\dot X + G(X,\dot X) = 0$, $X(0)=x_0,\dot X(0)=0$, with directional subgradient $G$.

nodes.name: Existence and uniqueness of solution to the ODE
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}_\infty$ and $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$, the ODE $\ddot X + (3/t)\dot X + \nabla f(X) = 0$ with $X(0)=x_0$, $\dot X(0)=0$ has a unique global solution $X \in C^2((0,\infty);\mathbb{R}^n) \cap C^1([0,\infty);\mathbb{R}^n)$.
conclusions: ODE has a unique global solution $X \in C^2((0,\infty);\mathbb{R}^n) \cap C^1([0,\infty);\mathbb{R}^n)$

nodes.name: Convergence of Nesterov's scheme to the ODE
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}_\infty$ and any $T>0$, Nesterov's scheme converges to the ODE solution: $\lim_{s\to 0}\max_{0\le k\le T/\sqrt{s}}\|x_k - X(k\sqrt{s})\| = 0$.

nodes.name: Inverse-quadratic convergence of the ODE
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}_\infty$ and the unique solution $X(t)$ to the ODE, $f(X(t)) - f^\star \le \frac{2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{t^2}$ for all $t>0$.
assumptions: $X$ is the unique global solution to the ODE with $X(0)=x_0$, $\dot X(0)=0$

nodes.name: Oscillation roots for strongly convex 1D $f$
nodes.statement: For $f \in \mathcal{S}_{\mu,L}(\mathbb{R})$, the positive roots $0<t_1<t_2<\ldots$ of $X(t)-x^\star$ satisfy $t_1 < 7.6635/\sqrt{\mu}$, $t_{i+1}-t_i < 7.6635/\sqrt{\mu}$, and $t_{i+2}-t_i > \pi/\sqrt{L}$.
assumptions: $X$ solves the ODE; $0<t_1<t_2<\ldots$ are roots of $X(t)-x^\star$

nodes.name: High-friction convergence of generalized ODE
nodes.statement: The solution $X$ of the generalized ODE with damping $r/t$ satisfies $f(X(t))-f^\star \le \frac{(r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2t^2}$ and $\int_0^\infty t(f(X(t))-f^\star)\d t \le \frac{(r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2(r-3)}$.

nodes.name: Discrete high-friction convergence
nodes.statement: For $0 < s \le 1/L$ and the generalized Nesterov's scheme with parameter $r$, $f(x_k)-f^\star \le \frac{(r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2s(k+r-2)^2}$ and $\sum_{k=1}^\infty (k+r-1)(f(x_k)-f^\star) \le \frac{(r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2s(r-3)}$.

nodes.name: Low-friction convergence under convex $(f-f^\star)^{(r-1)/2}$
nodes.statement: Suppose $1<r<3$ and $X$ solves the generalized ODE. If $(f-f^\star)^{(r-1)/2}$ is convex, then $f(X(t))-f^\star \le \frac{(r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2t^2}$.

nodes.name: Higher-rate convergence for strongly convex $f$ (continuous)
nodes.statement: For $f \in \mathcal{S}_{\mu,L}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and $2 \le \alpha \le 2r/3$, the solution to the generalized ODE satisfies $f(X(t))-f^\star \le \frac{C\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{\mu^{(\alpha-2)/2} t^{\alpha}}$ for all $t>0$, with $C$ depending only on $\alpha,r$.

nodes.name: $O(1/k^3)$ rate for generalized scheme on strongly convex $f$
nodes.statement: For $f = g+h$ with $g \in \mathcal{S}_{\mu,L}$ and $h$ convex extended-real, the generalized Nesterov's scheme with $r \ge 9/2$ and $s = 1/L$ satisfies $f(x_k)-f^\star \le \frac{CL\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{k^2}\frac{\sqrt{L/\mu}}{k}$.

nodes.name: Linear convergence under speed restarting
nodes.statement: There exist $c_1,c_2>0$ depending only on $L/\mu$ such that for any $f \in \mathcal{S}_{\mu,L}$, the speed-restarted ODE solution satisfies $f(X^{\mathrm{sr}}(t)) - f^\star \le \frac{c_1 L\|x_0-x^\star\|^2}{2}e^{-c_2 t\sqrt{L}}$.
assumptions: $X^{\mathrm{sr}}$ is the solution of the speed-restarted ODE

nodes.name: Inverse-quadratic rate for composite ODE
nodes.statement: If the ODE $\ddot X + (3/t)\dot X + G(X,\dot X) = 0$ admits a solution $X(t)$ on $[0,\alpha)$, then $f(X(t))-f^\star \le 2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/t^2$ for all $0<t<\alpha$.

nodes.name: Existence of ODE solution
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}_\infty$ and $x_0 \in \mathbb{R}^n$, the ODE has at least one solution $X \in C^2(0,\infty)\cap C^1[0,\infty)$.
conclusions: ODE has a solution $X \in C^2(0,\infty)\cap C^1[0,\infty)$

nodes.name: Bound on $M_\delta(\delta)$
nodes.statement: For $\delta < \sqrt{6/L}$, $M_\delta(\delta) \le \frac{\|\nabla f(x_0)\|}{1 - L\delta^2/6}$.

nodes.name: Lipschitz-gradient bound for smoothed ODE
nodes.statement: For any $u>0$, $\|\nabla f(X_\delta(u)) - \nabla f(x_0)\| \le \tfrac12 L M_\delta(u) u^2$.

nodes.name: Bound on $M_\delta(t)$ for $t>\delta$
nodes.statement: For $\delta < \sqrt{6/L}$ and $\delta < t < \sqrt{12/L}$, $M_\delta(t) \le \frac{(5-L\delta^2/6)\|\nabla f(x_0)\|}{4(1-L\delta^2/6)(1-Lt^2/12)}$.

nodes.name: Equicontinuity / uniform-boundedness of $\{X_\delta\}$
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{F} = \{X_\delta : [0,\sqrt{6/L}]\to\mathbb{R}^n \mid \delta = \sqrt{3/L}/2^m, m=0,1,\ldots\}$ is uniformly bounded and equicontinuous.

nodes.name: Local uniqueness of ODE solution
nodes.statement: For any $f \in \mathcal{F}_\infty$, the ODE has at most one local solution in a neighborhood of $t=0$.
conclusions: At most one local solution near $t=0$

nodes.name: Two-trajectory gradient bound
nodes.statement: For any $t \in (0,\alpha)$ and two solutions $X,Y$ of the ODE on $(0,\alpha)$, $\|\nabla f(X(t)) - \nabla f(Y(t))\| \le L t \tilde M(t)$ where $\tilde M(t) = \sup_{u\in[0,t)}\|\dot X(u)-\dot Y(u)\|$.

nodes.name: Euler-vs-Nesterov error bound
nodes.statement: With $\Delta t = \sqrt{s}$, for any $T>0$, $\max_{1\le k \le T/\sqrt{s}} \|X^\delta_k - x_k\| \le C\delta^2 + o_s(1)$ for some constant $C$.

nodes.name: Rockafellar directional-derivative formula
nodes.statement: For any convex $f$ and $x,p \in \mathbb{R}^n$, $\lim_{s\to 0+} (f(x+sp)-f(x))/s = \sup_{\xi\in\partial f(x)} \langle\xi,p\rangle$.

nodes.name: Constant-factor decay across one speed restart
nodes.statement: There is a universal constant $C>0$ such that $f(X(T)) - f^\star \le (1 - C\mu/L)(f(x_0) - f^\star)$.
assumptions: $T = T(x_0;f)$ is the speed restarting time

nodes.name: Upper bound on speed restarting time
nodes.statement: There is a universal constant $\tilde C$ such that $T \le \frac{4 \exp(\tilde C L/\mu)}{5\sqrt{L}}$.

nodes.name: Lower bound on speed restarting time
Phase transition at $r=3$
nodes.statement: For the generalized ODE/scheme with damping $r/t$, inverse-quadratic $O(1/t^2)$ convergence holds iff $r \ge 3$; the worst-case constant is minimized at $r=3$.

nodes.name: Time invariance of the ODE
nodes.statement: Under linear time rescaling $\tilde t = ct$, the ODE for $X(\tilde t)$ is again $\ddot X + (3/\tilde t)\dot X + \nabla f(X)/c^2 = 0$, equivalent to minimizing $f/c^2$. Time invariance holds iff the velocity coefficient has the form $C/t$.

nodes.name: Initial asymptotic of ODE solution
nodes.statement: Assuming $\lim_{t\to 0}\ddot X(t)$ exists, $\ddot X(0) = -\nabla f(x_0)/4$ and $X(t) = -\nabla f(x_0)t^2/8 + x_0 + o(t^2)$ for small $t$.

nodes.name: Tightness of the constant 2
nodes.statement: The bound $f(X(t))-f^\star \le 2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/t^2$ is tight: for $f(x)=x$ on $\mathbb{R}_+$ with $x_0>0$, the maximum of $t^2(f(X(t))-f^\star)$ equals $2x_0^2$, achieved at $t=2\sqrt{x_0}$.

nodes.name: Numerical-stability step size from forward Euler
nodes.statement: The forward-Euler discretization of the ODE is numerically stable when $\Delta t < 2/\sqrt{L}$, corresponding to step size $s=1/L$ in Nesterov; gradient descent's analogous bound is $\Delta t \le 2/L$.

nodes.name: Bessel-function representation for quadratic $f$
nodes.statement: For $f(x)=\tfrac12 \langle x,\Lambda x\rangle$, the ODE solution decouples into $X_i(t) = \frac{2 x_{0,i}}{t\sqrt{\lambda_i}}J_1(t\sqrt{\lambda_i})$, giving $f(X(t)) = O(\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/(t^3\sqrt{\min\lambda_i}))$.

nodes.name: Provable linear rate for gradient restarting
nodes.statement: Is there a provable linear convergence rate for the gradient restarting scheme of Nesterov's method analogous to the linear rate established in Theorem 10 for speed restarting?

nodes.name: General ODE-to-discrete translation theory
nodes.statement: Develop a general theory mapping properties of continuous ODEs into corresponding properties for discrete update schemes, allowing analysis to be carried out only at the ODE level.

nodes.name: Two-dimensional quadratic showing oscillations
nodes.statement: Minimize $f = 2\times 10^{-2}x_1^2 + 5\times 10^{-3}x_2^2$ from $x_0=(1,1)$; Nesterov's scheme exhibits butterfly-like oscillations with major period $10\pi$ and 2 minor peaks per major bump, matched by the Bessel-function ODE solution.

nodes.name: $r=1$ failure of inverse-quadratic rate
nodes.statement: For $f(x)=\tfrac12 x^2$ with $r=1$ in the generalized ODE/scheme starting from $x_0=1$, scaled errors $t^2(f(X(t))-f^\star)$ and $sk^2(f(x_k)-f^\star)$ grow with $t$/iterations, ruling out $O(1/t^2)$.

nodes.name: $f(x)=|x|$ counterexamples for $2\le r<3$
nodes.statement: For $f(x)=|x|$ with $r=2$ or $r=2.5$, the explicit piecewise solution shows $t^2(f(X(t))-f^\star)$ grows (linearly for $r=2$, sublinearly for $r=2.5$), violating $O(1/t^2)$.

nodes.name: Lasso square-root scaling demonstration
nodes.statement: Minimize $f(x)=\|y-Ax\|^2/2 + \|x\|_1$ with $y=(4,2,0)$ and specified columns of $A$ from $x_0=(2,0)$; iterates $x_k$ at $k \approx t_c/\sqrt{s}$ with the same $t_c$ are very close across $s$.

nodes.name: Six benchmark examples for generalized scheme
nodes.statement: Six synthetic benchmarks (lasso fat/square design, NLS fat/sparse design, logistic regression, $\ell_1$-regularized logistic) show smaller $r$ wins early, larger $r$ wins late.

nodes.name: Restarting benchmarks (quadratic, log-sum-exp, matrix completion, lasso, sorted-$\ell_1$, logistic)
nodes.statement: Speed-restarting empirically achieves linear convergence on quadratic, log-sum-exp ($\rho\log\sum e^{(a_i^Tx-b_i)/\rho}$), matrix completion, lasso, sorted-$\ell_1$, and logistic-regression problems, outperforming gradient restarting and original Nesterov.

nodes.name: Lasso composite example for directional subgradient
nodes.statement: For $\tfrac12\|y-Ax\|^2 + \lambda\|x\|_1$, a directional subgradient is $G(x,p) = -A^T(y-Ax) + \lambda \mathrm{sgn}(x,p)$, refined to encourage sparsity at coordinates where $x_i=p_i=0$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (existence/uniqueness)
nodes.statement: Combine Lemma 1 (existence via Arzelà-Ascoli on smoothed approximations) with Lemma 6 (local uniqueness via a Gronwall-style $\tilde M(t) \le Lt^2 \tilde M(t)/5$ contraction).

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 2 (limit of Nesterov to ODE)
nodes.statement: Triangle inequality $\|x_k-X(k\sqrt{s})\|$ via the smoothed ODE: bound $\|x_k - X^\delta_k\|$ by Lemma 8, $\|X^\delta_k - X_\delta(k\sqrt{s})\|$ by standard forward Euler, and $\|X_\delta(k\sqrt{s})-X(k\sqrt{s})\|$ via the convergent subsequence in Lemma 5.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 3 (ODE inverse-quadratic rate)
nodes.statement: Define energy $\mathcal{E}(t) = t^2(f(X(t))-f^\star) + 2\|X+ t\dot X/2 - x^\star\|^2$; substituting the ODE gives $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le 0$ via convexity, and monotonicity yields $f(X(t))-f^\star \le \mathcal{E}(0)/t^2 = 2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/t^2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 5 (high-friction continuous rate)
nodes.statement: Use energy $\mathcal{E}(t) = \frac{2t^2}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star) + (r-1)\|X + t\dot X/(r-1) - x^\star\|^2$; differentiation and convexity give $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le -2(r-3)t(f(X)-f^\star)/(r-1)$, yielding both inequalities.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 6 (discrete high-friction rate)
nodes.statement: Discrete energy $\mathcal{E}(k) = \frac{2(k+r-2)^2 s}{r-1}(f(x_k)-f^\star) + (r-1)\|z_k - x^\star\|^2$ with $z_k = ((k+r-1)y_k - kx_k)/(r-1)$; recursive inequality from the proximal-subgradient bound \eqref{eq:prox_ineq} summed appropriately gives both bounds.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 7 (low-friction with convex $(f-f^\star)^{(r-1)/2}$)
nodes.statement: Convexity of $(f-f^\star)^{(r-1)/2}$ gives $\frac{2}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star) \le \langle X-x^\star, \nabla f(X)\rangle$; combined with the energy derivative formula \eqref{eq:r_e_der} yields $\mathcal{E}(t)$ non-increasing, hence the bound.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 8 ($O(t^{-\alpha})$ continuous rate)
nodes.statement: Energy $\mathcal{E}(t;\alpha) = t^\alpha(f(X)-f^\star) + \frac{(2r-\alpha)^2 t^{\alpha-2}}{8}\|X + 2t\dot X/(2r-\alpha) - x^\star\|^2$; strong convexity bounds the cross term, then induction on $\alpha$ from the base case $2<\alpha\le 4$ yields the bound.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 9 ($O(1/k^3)$ discrete rate)
nodes.statement: Discrete energy \eqref{eq:dis_t3_energy} with strengthened proximal inequality \eqref{eq:str_prox} for strongly convex $g$; show $\Delta_k - \Delta_{k-1}$ recursion, bound auxiliary terms $\Pi_1, \Pi_2$, and combine with Theorem 6 for $k \le k^\star$ and the recursion for $k>k^\star$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 10 (linear rate of speed restarting)
nodes.statement: By Lemma 12 at least $m = \lfloor 5t\sqrt{L}e^{-\tilde C L/\mu}/4 \rfloor$ restartings have occurred; recursively applying Lemma 11 yields $f(X^{\mathrm{sr}}(t))-f^\star \le (1-C\mu/L)^m(f(x_0)-f^\star) \le c_1 e^{-c_2 t\sqrt{L}}(f(x_0)-f^\star)$, then bound by $L\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/2$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 11 (composite ODE rate)
nodes.statement: Show the energy $\mathcal{E}$ from the proof of Theorem 3 is monotonically decreasing despite non-differentiability: study $(\mathcal{E}(t+\Delta t)-\mathcal{E}(t))/\Delta t$ using local Lipschitzness of $f$ and Rockafellar's directional-derivative identity (Lemma 9).

nodes.name: Define energy functional $\mathcal{E}(t)$
nodes.statement: Set $\mathcal{E}(t) = t^2(f(X(t))-f^\star) + 2\|X + t\dot X/2 - x^\star\|^2$, viewed as a Lyapunov / negative-entropy functional.

nodes.name: Differentiate and substitute the ODE
nodes.statement: Compute $\dot{\mathcal{E}} = 2t(f(X)-f^\star) + t^2\langle\nabla f,\dot X\rangle + 4\langle X + t\dot X/2 - x^\star, 3\dot X/2 + t\ddot X/2\rangle$ and substitute $3\dot X/2 + t\ddot X/2 = -t\nabla f(X)/2$.

nodes.name: Apply convexity to get $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le 0$
nodes.statement: Simplification gives $\dot{\mathcal{E}} = 2t(f(X)-f^\star) - 2t\langle X-x^\star,\nabla f(X)\rangle \le 0$ by convexity of $f$.

nodes.name: Conclude via monotonicity
nodes.statement: From $\mathcal{E}(t)\le\mathcal{E}(0)$ and the second term being non-negative, $f(X(t))-f^\star \le \mathcal{E}(0)/t^2 = 2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/t^2$.

nodes.name: Define energy $\mathcal{E}(t)$ for parameter $r$
nodes.statement: Set $\mathcal{E}(t) = \frac{2t^2}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star) + (r-1)\|X + t\dot X/(r-1) - x^\star\|^2$.

nodes.name: Compute $\dot{\mathcal{E}}$ using $r\dot X + t\ddot X = -t\nabla f$
nodes.statement: Substitute $r\dot X + t\ddot X = -t\nabla f(X)$ and apply convexity to obtain $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le -\frac{2(r-3)t}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star)$.

nodes.name: Derive pointwise bound from monotonicity
nodes.statement: Since $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le 0$ and $f(X)\ge f^\star$, $\frac{2t^2}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star) \le \mathcal{E}(0) = (r-1)\|x_0-x^\star\|^2$, giving the first inequality.

nodes.name: Integrate to obtain integral bound
nodes.statement: Integrating the inequality $\frac{2(r-3)t}{r-1}(f(X)-f^\star) \le -\dot{\mathcal{E}}$ from $0$ to $\infty$ yields $\int_0^\infty t(f(X)-f^\star)\d t \le (r-1)^2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/(2(r-3))$.

nodes.name: Define discrete energy $\mathcal{E}(k)$
nodes.statement: Set $\mathcal{E}(k) = \frac{2(k+r-2)^2 s}{r-1}(f(x_k)-f^\star) + (r-1)\|z_k-x^\star\|^2$ with $z_k = ((k+r-1)y_k - kx_k)/(r-1)$.

nodes.name: Establish recursive inequality
nodes.statement: Sum $\frac{k-1}{k+r-2}\times$\eqref{eq:prox_ineq} at $(x_{k-1},y_{k-1})$ and $\frac{r-1}{k+r-2}\times$\eqref{eq:prox_ineq} at $(x^\star,y_{k-1})$ to derive $\mathcal{E}(k) + \frac{2s[(r-3)(k+r-2)+1]}{r-1}(f(x_{k-1})-f^\star) \le \mathcal{E}(k-1)$.

nodes.name: Telescope and conclude both inequalities
nodes.statement: Recursively summing the inequality and lower-bounding the LHS by $\frac{2s(k+r-2)^2}{r-1}(f(x_k)-f^\star)$ proves the first bound; taking $k\to\infty$ gives the second.

nodes.name: Define $\alpha$-energy $\mathcal{E}(t;\alpha)$
nodes.statement: Set $\mathcal{E}(t;\alpha) = t^\alpha(f(X)-f^\star) + \frac{(2r-\alpha)^2 t^{\alpha-2}}{8}\|X + 2t\dot X/(2r-\alpha) - x^\star\|^2$.

nodes.name: Bound $\dot{\mathcal{E}}$ using strong convexity
nodes.statement: Strong convexity bounds $\langle X-x^\star,\nabla f(X)\rangle$ from below; with $r \ge 3\alpha/2$, for $t\ge t_\alpha = \sqrt{(\alpha-2)(2r-\alpha)/(2\mu)}$, $\dot{\mathcal{E}} \le \frac{(\alpha-2)(2r-\alpha)t^{\alpha-2}}{8}\frac{\d\|X-x^\star\|^2}{\d t}$.

nodes.name: Base case $2<\alpha\le 4$
nodes.statement: Apply Theorem 5 to bound $\|X(t)-x^\star\|^2$ via $f(X)-f^\star$, derive bound on $\mathcal{E}(t)$, then use $f-f^\star \le \mathcal{E}(t)/t^\alpha$ for $t\ge t_\alpha$ and Theorem 5 directly for $t<t_\alpha$.

nodes.name: Inductive step $\alpha = \tilde\alpha + 1$
nodes.statement: Assume bound holds at $\tilde\alpha$, plug into the derivative inequality for $\mathcal{E}(t;\alpha)$, and verify the bound at $\alpha$ provided $r \ge 3\alpha/2$.

nodes.name: Lower bound on number of restarts at time $t$
nodes.statement: By Lemma 12, by time $t$ at least $m = \lfloor 5t\sqrt{L} e^{-\tilde C L/\mu}/4 \rfloor$ restartings have occurred for $X^{\mathrm{sr}}$.

nodes.name: Recursive constant-factor decay
nodes.statement: Applying Lemma 11 across $m$ restarts gives $f(X^{\mathrm{sr}}(t))-f^\star \le (1-C\mu/L)^m (f(x_0)-f^\star)$.

nodes.name: Convert to exponential and to $\|x_0-x^\star\|^2$ bound
nodes.statement: Using $(1-C\mu/L)^m \le e^{-C\mu m/L}$ gives $c_1 e^{-c_2 t\sqrt{L}}(f(x_0)-f^\star)$, then bound $f(x_0)-f^\star \le L\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/2$.

nodes.name: Reduce to monotonicity of $\mathcal{E}$
nodes.statement: It suffices to show the same energy $\mathcal{E}$ from the smooth proof is monotonically decreasing; since $\mathcal{E}$ may not be differentiable, study $(\mathcal{E}(t+\Delta t)-\mathcal{E}(t))/\Delta t$.

nodes.name: Expand the differentiable second term
nodes.statement: Differentiate $2\|X + t\dot X/2 - x^\star\|^2$ to get $4\langle X + t\dot X/2 - x^\star, 3\dot X/2 + t\ddot X/2\rangle$, and substitute the ODE $\ddot X + (3/t)\dot X + G(X,\dot X) = 0$.

nodes.name: Use Rockafellar's directional formula on first term
nodes.statement: By Lemma 9 (Rockafellar), $f(X + \Delta t\dot X) = f(X) + \Delta t\langle\dot X, G(X,\dot X)\rangle + o(\Delta t)$, controlling $f(X(t+\Delta t))$ to first order.

nodes.name: Combine via convexity, conclude monotonicity
nodes.statement: Combining gives $\mathcal{E}(t+\Delta t)-\mathcal{E}(t) \le 2t(f(X)-f^\star)\Delta t - 2t\langle X-x^\star, G\rangle\Delta t + o(\Delta t) \le o(\Delta t)$ by convexity, so $\mathcal{E}$ is non-increasing and $f(X(t))-f^\star \le 2\|x_0-x^\star\|^2/t^2$.

nodes.name: Initialize iterates and counter
nodes.statement: Set $y_0 = x_0$, $x_{-1} = x_0$, restart counter $j \gets 1$.

nodes.name: Outer loop over $k = 1$ to $k_{\max}$
nodes.statement: For $k = 1, \ldots, k_{\max}$: perform proximal Nesterov step using counter $j$, then test the speed-restart criterion and update $j$ accordingly.

nodes.name: Proximal-gradient update for $x_k$
nodes.statement: $x_k \gets \arg\min_x (\tfrac{1}{2s}\|x - y_{k-1} + s\nabla g(y_{k-1})\|^2 + h(x))$.

nodes.name: Momentum extrapolation using counter $j$
nodes.statement: $y_k \gets x_k + \frac{j-1}{j+2}(x_k - x_{k-1})$.

nodes.name: Speed-restart test and counter update
nodes.statement: If $\|x_k - x_{k-1}\| < \|x_{k-1}-x_{k-2}\|$ and $j \ge k_{\min}$ then $j \gets 1$, else $j \gets j+1$.
